Maya Chen: FYI — Meridian QBR booked Thu May 6 09:00 PT. Goal: 1-page executive narrative + 4 slides, 4-min demo clip, and a single commercial ask (pilot extension + success credits). Who can own the one-pager?

Ravi Kumar: I can draft the exec one-pager. Will focus on outcomes, churn risk, and the specific ask. ETA Tue noon for draft.

Sasha Li: I'll pull onboarding cadence & health signals (activation, time-to-value, support volume). Any particular KPIs to prioritize?

Maya Chen: Prioritize activation rate, weekly active seats, and time-to-first-success. Also add renewal signal (green/amber/red) per account.

Tom Jenkins: I'll do the deck assembly and short design polish so it looks exec-ready. Will slot a demo placeholder (4-min clip).

Ben Sales: I'll own the commercial framing. Recommend pilot extension + 3 success workshops. Happy to rehearse the ask wording with execs.

QBR Bot: QBR checklist: https://redwood.slides/qbr-checklist-v3 :white_check_mark: 

Sasha Li: Quick flags: two integration tickets blocking automation (INT-991, INT-1002). Pilot cohort uptake behind forecast by 14% — will note remediation.

Ravi Kumar: Drafted one-pager and pasted to /QBRs/Meridian/2026-05-06/onepager.md. Short summary at top and recommended next steps.

Maya Chen: Nice. Tom — can you add a final slide with "ask + success plan" so Ben can rehearse?

Tom Jenkins: Done. Pushed updated deck to shared drive. Added slide notes for Ben's talking points.

Ben Sales: Reviewing now. Suggest swapping the order: move the commercial ask earlier (slide 2) so execs hear it up front.

Maya Chen: Agree — move ask to slide 2. Also we need a 15-min rehearsal Tues 08:00 PT. Can everyone make it?

Ravi Kumar: I can make the rehearsal.

Sasha Li: In.

Tom Jenkins: In.

Ben Sales: In.

Maya Chen: Great. Quick contingency: if sandbox demo fails, we'll show a 4-min recorded clip and run live Q&A. Noah on infra promised to prioritize the sandbox refresh.

QBR Bot: Reminder set: Rehearsal Tue 08:00 PT — Calendar invites sent.

Maya Chen: Action tracker (paste into /QBRs/Meridian/2026-05-06/actions.md):

```
Owner | Task | Due
Ravi K | Exec one-pager draft | 2026-05-05 12:00
Sasha L | Health KPIs + risk flags | 2026-05-05 EOD
Tom J | Deck assemble + polish | 2026-05-05 EOD
Ben S | Commercial ask + slides | 2026-05-05 15:00
Maya C | Exec outreach & rehearsal lead | 2026-05-05 EOD
```

Tom Jenkins: Added the tracker. Will tweak visuals for slide 1.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. After rehearsal I'll ping execs and attach the 1-pager. :star:
